verses.en: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
verses.pt: Fez também Bezalel a arca de madeira de acácia: seu comprimento era de dois côvados e meio, e de côvado e meio sua largura, e sua altura de outro côvado e meio:
verses.en_web: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.en_bbe: And Bezalel made the ark of hard wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide and a cubit and a half high;

verses.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
verses.pt: E cobriu-a de ouro puro por de dentro e por de fora, e fez-lhe uma borda de ouro em derredor.
verses.en_web: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.
verses.en_bbe: Plating it inside and out with the best gold, and putting an edge of gold all round it.

verses.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
verses.pt: Fez-lhe também de fundição quatro anéis de ouro a seus quatro cantos; em um lado dois anéis e no outro lado dois anéis.
verses.en_web: He cast four rings of gold for it, in its four feet; even two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.
verses.en_bbe: And he made four gold rings for its four angles, two on one side and two on the other,

verses.en: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.pt: Fez também as varas de madeira de acácia, e cobriu-as de ouro.
verses.en_web: He made poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.en_bbe: And rods of the same wood plated with gold.

verses.en: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
verses.pt: E meteu as varas pelos anéis aos lados da arca, para levar a arca.
verses.en_web: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
verses.en_bbe: These rods he put in the rings at the sides of the ark, for lifting it.

verses.en: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.pt: Fez também a coberta de ouro puro: seu comprimento de dois côvados e meio, e sua largura de côvado e meio.
verses.en_web: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the cover all of gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

verses.en: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
verses.pt: Fez também os dois querubins de ouro, os fez lavrados a martelo, aos duas extremidades do propiciatório:
verses.en_web: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat;
verses.en_bbe: And he made two winged ones, hammered out of one bit of gold, for the two ends of the cover;

verses.en: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.pt: Um querubim desta parte ao um extremo, e o outro querubim da outra parte ao outro extremo do propiciatório: fez os querubins a suas duas extremidades.
verses.en_web: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.
verses.en_bbe: Placing one at one end and one at the other; the winged ones were part of the cover.

verses.en: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
verses.pt: E os querubins estendiam suas asas por cima, cobrindo com suas asas o propiciatório: e seus rostos um em frente do outro, até o propiciatório os rostos dos querubins.
verses.en_web: The cherubim spread out their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.
verses.en_bbe: And their wings were stretched out over the cover; the faces of the winged ones were opposite one another and facing the cover.

verses.en: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
verses.pt: Fez também a mesa de madeira de acácia; seu comprimento de dois côvados, e sua largura de um côvado, e de côvado e meio sua altura;
verses.en_web: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the table of hard wood, two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high;

verses.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
verses.pt: E cobriu-a de ouro puro, e fez-lhe uma borda de ouro em derredor.
verses.en_web: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.
verses.en_bbe: Plating it with the best gold and putting a gold edge all round it.

verses.en: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
verses.pt: Fez-lhe também uma moldura ao redor, da largura de uma mão, à qual moldura fez a borda de ouro ao redor.
verses.en_web: He made a border of a hand width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.
verses.en_bbe: And he made a frame all round it about as wide as a man's hand, edged with gold all round.

verses.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
verses.pt: Fez-lhe também de fundição quatro anéis de ouro, e os pôs aos quatro cantos que correspondiam aos quatro pés dela.
verses.en_web: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.
verses.en_bbe: And he made four gold rings, and put the rings at the angles of its four feet.

verses.en: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
verses.pt: Diante da moldura estavam os anéis, pelos quais se metessem as varas para levar a mesa.
verses.en_web: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.
verses.en_bbe: The rings were fixed under the frame to take the rods with which the table was to be lifted.

verses.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
verses.pt: E fez as varas de madeira de acácia para levar a mesa, e cobriu-as de ouro.
verses.en_web: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
verses.en_bbe: The rods for lifting the table he made of hard wood plated with gold.

verses.en: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.
verses.pt: Também fez os utensílios que haviam de estar sobre a mesa, seus pratos, e suas colheres, e suas tigelas e suas bacias com que se havia de fazer libações, de ouro fino.
verses.en_web: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.
verses.en_bbe: And all the table-vessels, the plates and spoons and basins and the cups for liquids, he made of the best gold.

verses.en: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
verses.pt: Fez também o candelabro de ouro puro, e o fez lavrado a martelo: seu pé e sua haste, seus copos, seus botões e suas flores eram do mesmo.
verses.en_web: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.
verses.en_bbe: Then he made the support for the lights, all of the best gold; its base and its pillar were of hammered gold; its cups and buds and flowers were all made out of the same metal:

verses.en: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
verses.pt: De seus lados saíam seis braços; três braços de um lado do candelabro, e outros três braços do outro lado do candelabro:
verses.en_web: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:
verses.en_bbe: It had six branches coming out from its sides, three from one side and three from the other;

verses.en: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
verses.pt: Em um braço, três copos forma de amêndoas, um botão e uma flor; e no outro braço três copos forma de amêndoas, um botão e uma flor: e assim nos seis braços que saíam do candelabro.
verses.en_web: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower: so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
verses.en_bbe: Every branch having three cups made like almond flowers, every cup with a bud and a flower on all the branches;

verses.en: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
verses.pt: E no candelabro havia quatro copos forma de amêndoas, seus botões e suas flores:
verses.en_web: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
verses.en_bbe: And on its pillar, four cups like almond flowers, every one with its bud and its flower;

verses.en: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
verses.pt: E um botão debaixo dos dois braços do mesmo, e outro botão debaixo dos outros dois braços do mesmo, e outro botão debaixo dos outros dois braços do mesmo, conforme os seis braços que saíam dele.
verses.en_web: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.
verses.en_bbe: And under every two branches a bud, made with the branch, for all six branches of it.

verses.en: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.pt: Seus botões e seus braços eram do mesmo; tudo era uma peça lavrada a martelo, de ouro puro.
verses.en_web: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.en_bbe: The buds and the branches were made of the same metal, all together one complete work of the best hammered gold.

verses.en: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.
verses.pt: Fez também suas sete lâmpadas, e seus tenazes, e seus apagadores, de ouro puro;
verses.en_web: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the seven vessels for the lights, and all the necessary instruments for it, of gold.

verses.en: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
verses.pt: De um talento de ouro puro o fez, com todos os seus utensílios.
verses.en_web: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.
verses.en_bbe: A talent of the best gold was used for the making of it and its vessels.

verses.en: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
verses.pt: Fez também o altar do incenso de madeira de acácia: um côvado seu comprimento, e outro côvado sua largura, era quadrado; e sua altura de dois côvados; e suas pontas da mesma peça.
verses.en_web: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the altar for the burning of spices, using the same hard wood; it was square, a cubit long and a cubit wide and two cubits high; the horns made of the same.

verses.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.pt: E cobriu-o de ouro puro, sua mesa e suas paredes ao redor, e suas pontas: e fez-lhe uma coroa de ouro ao redor.
verses.en_web: He overlaid it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.
verses.en_bbe: The top and the sides and the horns were all plated with the best gold; and he put an edge of gold all round it.

verses.en: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
verses.pt: Fez-lhe também dois anéis de ouro debaixo da coroa nos dois cantos aos dois lados, para passar por eles as varas com que havia de ser conduzido.
verses.en_web: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.
verses.en_bbe: And he made two gold rings, placing them on the two opposite sides under the edge, to take the rods for lifting it.

verses.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.pt: E fez as varas de madeira de acácia, e cobriu-as de ouro.
verses.en_web: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.en_bbe: The rods he made of the same hard wood, plating them with gold.

verses.en: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
verses.pt: Fez também o azeite santo da unção, e o fino incenso aromático, de obra de perfumista.
verses.en_web: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the holy oil and the perfume of sweet spices for burning, after the art of the perfume-maker.
